title: Replace the Supabase access token before 1 February 2027
body:
Claude Code's Supabase access token (Doppler project `hrizzup-tools`, config `claude`, name `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`) expires around 1 February 2027. After that, Claude Code can't check or manage the staging database.

1. In Supabase, open your account's **Access Tokens** page and create a new token with the same scope as the current one: full access to the project `hrizzup-staging` only, no account or organisation access, expiring in 90 days. Never paste it into a chat.
2. In Doppler's dashboard, open project `hrizzup-tools`, config `claude`, and replace the value of `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` with the new token (same name).
3. Back in Supabase, delete the old token.
4. Tell Claude Code: "the Supabase token is replaced". Claude Code checks that the new token works and sees only `hrizzup-staging`, records it in `docs/setup.md`, and adds the next reminder to `.github/reminders.json`.

Reference: `docs/setup/RUNBOOK.md`, Part 5, the reminder about the Supabase token.

title: Replace the Vercel token before 1 February 2027
body:
Claude Code's Vercel token (Doppler project `hrizzup-tools`, config `claude`, name `VERCEL_TOKEN`, named "Claude Code – hrizzup" in Vercel) expires around 1 February 2027. After that, Claude Code can't check or change the Vercel project's settings.

1. In Vercel, open your account's **Settings → Tokens** and create a new token named "Claude Code – hrizzup", scope: the team **Hrizzup** only, expiring in 90 days. Never paste it into a chat.
2. In Doppler's dashboard, open project `hrizzup-tools`, config `claude`, and replace the value of `VERCEL_TOKEN` with the new token (same name). Never put it in the project `hrizzup`: that one is synced into Vercel's builds.
3. Back in Vercel, delete the old token.
4. Tell Claude Code: "the Vercel token is replaced". Claude Code checks it sees only the team Hrizzup, runs `infra/vercel/apply.py --check`, records it in `docs/setup.md`, and adds the next reminder here.

Reference: `docs/setup/RUNBOOK.md`, Part 9, the reminder about the Vercel token.

title: Check the release pipeline's Supabase token before it expires
body:
The release pipeline's Supabase access token (Doppler project `hrizzup`, config `prd_release`, name `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`, named "Hrizzup release pipeline" in Supabase) was created in runbook Part 10 with the longest expiry Supabase offered. Without it, the pipeline can't apply production's project and sign-in settings, so releases stop.

1. In Supabase, open your picture (top right) → **Account preferences** → **Access Tokens**, and look at the expiry date of "Hrizzup release pipeline". If it is more than a month away, close this issue and set a new reminder in `.github/reminders.json` a few weeks before it (ask Claude Code).
2. Otherwise, **Generate new token** with the same scope: the project `hrizzup-production` only, full access, no account or organisation access, the longest expiry offered. Never paste it into a chat.
3. In Doppler's dashboard, open project `hrizzup`, config `prd_release`, and replace the value of `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (same name).
4. Back in Supabase, delete the old token.
5. Tell Claude Code: "the pipeline's Supabase token is replaced". Claude Code runs the release pipeline's checks on the next release and adds the next reminder here.

Reference: `docs/setup/RUNBOOK.md`, Part 10, your checklist, step B.

title: Replace the release pipeline's Vercel and Cloudflare tokens before November 2027
body:
The release pipeline's Vercel token (`VERCEL_TOKEN`, "Hrizzup release pipeline") and Cloudflare token (`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, "Hrizzup release pipeline (R2 settings)"), both in Doppler project `hrizzup`, config `prd_release`, were created in runbook Part 10 (3 November 2026 or soon after) for 1 year. Without them, the pipeline can't promote builds or apply production's storage rules.

1. **Vercel:** your picture → **Account Settings → Tokens** → create a new token named `Hrizzup release pipeline`, scope Hrizzup, 1 year. In Doppler `prd_release`, replace `VERCEL_TOKEN` with it, then delete the old token in Vercel.
2. **Cloudflare:** the person icon → **My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token → Create Custom Token**: name `Hrizzup release pipeline (R2 settings)`, one row **Account · Workers R2 Storage · Edit**, your account, TTL 1 year. In Doppler `prd_release`, replace `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, then delete the old token in Cloudflare.
3. Never paste either into a chat. Tell Claude Code when both are replaced; it adds the next reminder here.

Reference: `docs/setup/RUNBOOK.md`, Part 10, your checklist, step H.
